# Exercise execution syntax.
app Execution
context
 theme density=compact
Given
 contract Result {value:int}
 Item {title:text,active:bool=true}
 event Changed {item:Item}
 policy Item read=members
When
 scenario report() by=members read=true -> Result
  do
   return {value=1}
 scenario loop(values:int[]) by=members
  do
   for in in values limit=1
    let value=in
   for return in values limit=1
    let chosen=return
 scenario mutate(input:Item) by=members
  require input.active
  do
   require input.active message="Required"
   set input {active=false}
 scenario execute(input:Item) by=members
  require input.active
  do
   create Item {title="New"} as created
   set created {active=false}
   call mutate {input=created}
   emit Changed {item=created}
   schedule "reminder" at=now+1h event=Changed {item=created}
   cancel "reminder"
   delete created
   return created.title
Then
 page /items title="Items"
  require members
  table Item columns=title,active
   card "Item"
    text row.title
    edit
    delete
    actions mutate
    history

# Exercise CRUD example tables.
app CrudExamples
Given
 Item {title:text}
 policy Item read=members
 fixture initial=Item {title="One"}
When
 crud Item by=members fields=title
  examples create
   title -> count(Item)
   "One" -> 1
  examples update record=initial
   changes.title -> initial.title
   "Two" -> "Two"
  examples delete record=initial
   as -> count(Item)
   members -> 0
Then

app ScenarioExamples

  do return title
  examples delete="d" action="a" history="h"
   title -> result
   "One" -> "One"
Then

# Keep expression names and actual clauses distinct.
app Queries
Given
 Item {active:bool=true,title:text,return:bool,where:bool,select:Item[]}
 policy Item read=members
 derive active(value:Item):bool=value.return and true
 derive inactive(value:Item):bool=value.where or false
 derive names(value:Item):Item[]=value.select as item select item
 derive choose(values:Item[]):Item[]=values as where where where.active
 derive froms(from:Item[]):Item[]=from as order where order.active select order
 derive precedence(and:bool,or:bool,in:bool):bool=and or in
 derive arithmetic(and:int):int=1 * and
When
Then
 page /items title="Items"
  list Item as list where list.active columns=title

# Preserve joined query clauses.
app Joined
Given
 Item {active:bool=true,title:text,return:bool}
 policy Item read=members
 derive names():text[]=(Item
  as item
  where item.active
  order=-item.created
  select item.title
 )
 derive selected(values:Item[]):Item[]=(values
  as where
  where where.active
  select where
 )
 derive compare(value:Item):bool=(value.return
  and true
 )
When
Then

app Operators
Given

 derive multiply(and:int):int=2 * and
 derive prefix(value:bool):bool=not value and true
 derive is_value(in:int):bool=in==1
 derive joined(and:bool,in:bool):bool=(and
  or in
 )
When
Then

# Reuse canonical operation slots.
app Operations
Given
 Item {title:text,action:action(change)?}
 policy Item read=members
 capability Remote version=1
  run(input:Item)->text
When
 crud Item by=members fields=title
 scenario change(input:Item) by=members
  do set input {title="Changed"}
 scenario run(input:Item) by=members
  do
   call change {input}
   call (change) {input}
   call (
    change
   ) {input}
   send Remote.run {input} as delivery
   send (
    Remote.run
   ) {input} as joined_delivery
 scenario review(title:text) by=members read=true -> Item[]
  do return Item as item where item.title==title
 scenario refresh(title:text) by=members
  do create Item {title} as created
Then
 page /items title="Items" poll=5s refresh=refresh
  form refresh import=csv review=review
  list Item
   form change
   form (change)
   form (
    change
   )
   action change
   actions change,Item.update
   form row.action

# Separate presentation roles from execution.
app Presentation
Given
 Item {title:text,active:bool=true}
 policy Item read=members
 preferences {view:enum(all,active)=all}
When
 crud Item by=members fields=title,active
 scenario change(input:Item) by=members
  require input.active
  do set input {active=false}
Then
 page /items title="Items"
  require members
  card "Items"
   tabs preferences.view
   table Item as item where item.active columns=title,active order=-created
    require row.active
    title row.title
    text row.title
    content row.title
    metrics count(Item)
    copy row.title
    details "Details"
     edit fields=title
     delete
     action change
     form change
     history

# Preserve parenthesized operation targets.
app Qualified
Given
 Item {title:text}
 capability Remote version=1
  run(input:Item)->text
When
 crud Item by=members fields=title
 scenario run(input:Item) by=members
  do
   send (Remote.run) {input} as d1
   send ((Remote.run)) {input} as d2
   call (Item.update) {record=input,changes={title="Changed"}}
Then
 page / title="Actions"
  list Item
   form (Item.update)
   actions (Item.update),(Item.create)

# Keep every authored guard in the structural role.
app InlineGuards
Given
 Item {title:text,active:bool=true}
 policy Item read=members
When
 scenario change(input:Item) by=members
  require input.active
  do require input.active; require input.active; set input {title="Changed"}
 scenario body(input:Item) by=members
  do
   require input.active
   set input {title="Changed"}
Then
 page /items title="Items"
  require members
  list Item
   require row.active
   form change
